description: storage-engines.md tells the reader 'See Magma Flushing and Compaction Threads for more information about these settings' for settings it names but does not document; the settings themselves (num_storage_threads, magma_flusher_thread_percentage) are documented only in storage-settings.md's section of that name. Confirmed from both sides by the two pages' extraction records. Not a contradiction - a topic split across two files where the naming page and the documenting page are different, so neither is self-contained.
